name: mc_render
title: Render view
description:
Renders a region as a PNG so you can see terrain and builds: flat maps, facades, slices and heightmaps, shape-aware isometric/perspective schematics, and a first-person view from an eye.

WHEN TO USE: isometric/perspective for one appearance check of a finished build (stairs, slabs, doors, windows, depth). "top" for terrain shape, a footprint or how a structure sits on the land. "north"/"south"/"east"/"west" for a facade (windows, symmetry, roof lines). "slice" for a floor plan (axis "y") or a vertical cut. "heightmap" for relief (mc_survey adds the numbers). "first-person" for what a player sees from a spot, up to 256 blocks away.
WHEN NOT TO USE: for exact states, orientations or counts (mc_inspect): colours are map colours, not textures, and angled views use schematic shapes. To ask whether blocks are visible from a spot, use mc_sightline.

PARAMETERS: "top"/"heightmap" are priced by x/z area and the other views by volume (at most 200,000 each; isometric/perspective up to 2,000,000, config limits.max-render-volume); for a facade, limit y to the building. Angled views take `camera`, `compareTo` and `zoom` and need grid 0. "first-person" takes `eye` or `player` instead of from/to.

SIDE EFFECTS: read-only. Returns the image plus text: bounds, size, scale, axes and a legend of the most visible blocks (hex colour per block; heightmap: height bands and terrain numbers). PNGs are capped at 3 MB (scale halves automatically). First-person reads unloaded chunks too: they load in the background without generation (nearest first, up to config limits.max-view-chunk-loads) and are not kept loaded; never-generated chunks and chunks over that cap are drawn flat purple and counted as unknownPixels, never as air.

world.description: World name; default: the configured default world.

from.description: Inclusive corner: [x, y, z], or [x, z] for "top"/"heightmap" (the surface is found automatically; give y only to look under a roof or underground). Not used by "first-person".

to.description: Opposite inclusive corner, same shape as `from`.

view.description: "top" (default, shaded like an in-game map), "north"/"south"/"east"/"west" (the facade seen from that side), "slice" (exact colours, needs `slice`), "heightmap", "isometric"/"perspective" (schematic block shapes with depth; need 3D bounds), "first-person".

axis.description: "y": a floor plan at one layer; "x"/"z": a vertical cross-section.

scale.description: Pixels per block, 0-16 (angled views 0-32). Default 0 = auto: up to 16 px per block and about 1024 px on the longer side; angled views may reduce resolution to stay within their work budget and say so.

grid.description: Grid line with coordinate labels every N blocks. Default 10 for flat views; angled views need 0.

camera.description: Angled views only: azimuth (compass, north=0, east=90; default 135), elevation (default 35.26 isometric, 30 perspective), fov (perspective only, default 50).

compareTo.description: Angled views only: a snapshot id. Blocks changed since are tinted orange, added green, removed drawn as translucent red cubes; cells outside the snapshot are not compared. The text gives the counts.

zoom.description: Angled views only, instead of from/to: a cube of `radius` blocks (default 4, at most 16) around `pos`. Defaults to isometric and, for radius 4 or less, 32 px per block.

eye.description: first-person: eye position [x, y, z], decimals allowed (a standing player's eye is feet + 1.62). Give eye or player.

player.description: first-person: an online player; uses their eye and look direction (yaw/pitch override).

yaw.description: first-person: degrees as F3 shows them: 0 south, 90 west, 180 north, -90 east. Required with eye.

pitch.description: first-person: -90 up, 0 level, 90 down. Required with eye.

fov.description: first-person: vertical field of view, default 70.

distance.description: first-person: view distance in blocks, default 128.

height.description: first-person: image height, default 540; width*height at most 1,000,000.

heightmapType.description: heightmap only: surface type as in mc_survey. Default SOLID_OR_LIQUID_NO_LEAVES.

contour.description: heightmap only: contour line every N blocks of height; 0 disables. Default 5.
